Name: Nahshon, Son of Amminadab
Summary: Nahshon appears in Ruth's genealogy as the son of Amminadab and father of Salmon, in the line from Pharez to David.
KeyStory: Nahshon stands in the closing genealogy between Amminadab and Salmon, in the line that runs from Pharez to David.
RelatedPeople: Amminadab; Salmon, Son of Nahshon; Pharez
LifeLesson: A name in a list is a link in a chain that ends at Bethlehem's king.
